title: Technical English — Course 5, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 7

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the shift-handover lesson take place?
tasks.audioText: The maintenance operations tutor will discuss shift handover on Friday at nine fifteen. Students should bring the open-task list and the sample technical log extract. The lesson will focus on incomplete work, equipment status and clear responsibility for the next shift. Students will compare a brief note with a complete handover record.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which two records should students bring?
tasks.audioText: The maintenance operations tutor will discuss shift handover on Friday at nine fifteen. Students should bring the open-task list and the sample technical log extract. The lesson will focus on incomplete work, equipment status and clear responsibility for the next shift. Students will compare a brief note with a complete handover record.
options: The open-task list and technical log extract

tasks.prompt: A maintenance shift handover transfers current work information between teams. It should identify open tasks, completed checks, equipment or aircraft status and any restrictions. The outgoing team should state what remains outstanding and who is responsible for follow-up. A handover is not a substitute for the technical log or required sign-off; it helps the next team understand the current position. Reading 1. Which information should a handover identify?
options: Open tasks, completed checks, equipment status and restrictions

tasks.prompt: What does a handover not replace?
options: The technical log or required sign-off

tasks.prompt: Outstanding tasks ___ clearly during shift handover.
Choose TWO details that belong in a maintenance shift handover.
options: A personal opinion about the previous shift

tasks.prompt: The transfer of work information between teams at the end of a shift is a shift ___.
A task remains incomplete at the end of the shift. What should the handover say?
options: The task is finished; no further details are needed.
The task remains open; the outstanding action and responsible team are identified in the handover.
The next shift can decide what was left incomplete.
The task is complete if most of the work has been done.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of maintenance shift handover in a logical order.
options: Transfer the information to the next shift
correctOrder: Transfer the information to the next shift

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining what a maintenance shift handover should contain and why it does not replace required technical records or sign-off.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); accurate maintenance and quality vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2).
